script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. OFFICE - DAY

JAMES (30s, anxious, dressed in business casual) sits at his desk, eyes fixed on a blinking cursor on his computer screen. The phone rings, jolting him out of his trance.

JAMES
(into phone)
James Spears.

CAROLINE (voiceover, cheerful)
Hi, James! It's Caroline from marketing. I heard you're not feeling well?

James looks down at his trembling hands.

JAMES
(sighs)
Just a little under the weather. How are you?

INT. KITCHEN - CONTINUOUS

Caroline enters, holding a tray of cupcakes. She sets them down on the counter, smiles at JAMES, who hesitates before joining her.

CAROLINE
I brought these for the team! Thought we could all use a little sweetness today.

JAMES
(forcing a smile)
Thank you, Caroline. That's very thoughtful of you.

INT. OFFICE - LATER

James packs up his things, looking at his computer one last time.

JAMES
(whispering to himself)
This is it. I'm leaving.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

James says goodbye to his colleagues, who are shocked by his sudden departure. He walks out of the building, the weight of his decision settling on him.

INT. PARK - DAY

James sits on a bench, staring at the sun. A woman, MAYA (30s, friendly, carrying a notebook and pen), sits down next to him.

MAYA
Hi. I'm Maya. You work at the accounting firm down the street, right?

JAMES
(surprised)
Yes, that's me.

MAYA
I'm a freelance writer. I write for a living. Do you write?

JAMES
(shaking his head)
No, not really. I've always wanted to though.

MAYA
Well, I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. Why don't you give it a try?

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James and Maya sit at a table, surrounded by the hum of the coffee shop.

JAMES
I don't know where to start.

MAYA
Begin with something you love. What's your passion?

James looks thoughtful.

JAMES
I love history.

MAYA
(smiling)
History it is, then. Write about a little-known event in history. Make it captivating.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits at his kitchen table, a blank page in front of him. He starts to write, his pen moving across the paper with growing confidence.

INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - WEEKS LATER

Maya and James sit on her couch, surrounded by piles of research books and notebooks.

MAYA
You've really immersed yourself in this project. I'm proud of you.

JAMES
(smiling)
I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. PUBLIC LIBRARY - DAY

James and Maya sit at a table, surrounded by fellow researchers, engrossed in their work. They exchange a knowing glance.

MAYA
(whispering)
We're on to something.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Months later, James sits in a new office, his computer screen filled with his completed manuscript. He smiles, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

JAMES
(to himself)
I did it.

INT. BOOK STORE - DAY

James signs copies of his book for fans, surrounded by his proud family and colleagues. Maya, who wrote the foreword, stands beside him, beaming.

INT. PARK - DAY

James and Maya sit on a bench, watching the sunset.

JAMES
(smiling)
I couldn't have done it without you.

MAYA
(smiling back)
You're a natural, James. Remember that.

James takes her hand, and they watch the sun set together, the beginning of a beautiful new chapter in their lives.

FADE OUT.
